data.opportunityTitle: Fetal, Infant, and Child Death Review Program
data.modifiedComments: Updating eligibility. Public institutions of higher education and private institutions of higher education are eligible to apply.

topAgencyDetails.agencyName: Department of Health and Human Services

forecast.forecastDesc: This program will support coordinated leadership and technical assistance to state, local, and tribal fetal infant and child death review (FICDR) teams to ensure a standardized and coordinated approach for quality fatality reviews, data collection, and dissemination of findings to inform review team practice and local prevention strategies.
forecast.estApplicationResponseDateDesc: Electronically submitted applications must be submitted no later than 11:59 p.m., ET, on the listed application due date.
